global: {my_faction} and {enemy_faction} are at war again. My insurance rates just tripled, and nobody asked me first.
Declaring war is easy. Finding a wagon that gets through the mountain passes next month is the hard part.
Whoever started this war, please tell me which roads are still open before you set the bridges on fire.
Wars come and go, but the price of salt never comes back down. Funny how the bills always outlast the banners.
Any toll collector who holds my wagons this week will find I keep very careful records of who owes me.
Selling grain to anyone still hungry after this war. Name your price, I will load the cart by morning.
Bandits love a border war. Half my route is empty now and the other half is full of people with axes.
{enemy_faction} will need tents, sails and rope before this is over. Anyone with spare canvas, now is the time.
